description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Shackles for the Front or Rear Leaf Springs
This kit also includes the Bushings for the leaf springs shackles
Does Front or Rear Leaf Springs
Suzuki OEM
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 8 – Small Bushings
Qty 2 – Inner Shackles
Qty 2 – Outer Shackles
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
